"What is our plan outside China?"
Ours has run since 2024.
2countries, one management team
90–1200Tpresses in Bắc Ninh
ISO 9001same system, both sites
Post 1 · Vietnam capacity "What's your plan outside China?" is now a board-level question for most consumer brands. Our answer since 2024: the same management team, the same ISO 9001 system, two origins. Our Bắc Ninh facility runs 90–1,200 T presses, passed Target's factory audit, and holds GRS for recycled PP/ABS/PET. We are usually not the lowest unit price — and we say so up front. What you get is a yield and a ship date you can build a program around. If you have a finalized design and a defined annual volume, the feasibility review takes six questions. Link in comments. #injectionmolding #vietnammanufacturing #chinaplusone #sourcing #oem · Tue 09:00 CET · CTA: feasibility review page
Before we quote your part,
we quote your mold.
1989mold shop opened, Dongguan
50+R&D engineers
T1 → FAIbefore any mass run
Post 2 · Mold shop precision Most injection-molding quotes hide the number that matters: what the tool will cost you over its life, not what the part costs this quarter. We have designed and cut our own molds in Dongguan since 1989. So the DFM review comes first: gate position, wall thickness, draft, tolerance stack. Then T1 samples. Then first-article approval. Only then a production quote. Transferring an existing tool? We inspect, refurbish or modify it, then prove it out the same way. A part that molds cleanly for five years is cheaper than one that was quoted cheaply once. #moldmaking #dfm #injectionmolding #tooling #manufacturing · Thu 09:00 CET · CTA: mold manufacturing page
What a retail factory audit actually checks.
Targetfactory audit passed, Vietnam
SCAN · SMTAsecurity & social audits
GRSrecycled PP / ABS / PET
Post 3 · QC process A US retail factory audit is not a certificate on the wall. It is an auditor walking your line with a checklist: traceability of materials, calibration records, first-article documentation, social compliance, site security. Our Bắc Ninh facility passed Target's audit. It also holds SCAN (supply-chain security), SMTA (social/ethical) and GRS (recycled content) — and runs on the same ISO 9001 system as our Dongguan plant. Why it matters to a buyer: many low-cost local plants cannot pass this. If your program is going into a chain store, ask your supplier for the audit report before you ask for the price. #qualitycontrol #factoryaudit #retailsourcing #iso9001 #vietnam · Tue 09:00 CET · CTA: certifications section
